inventory_boundary.source_ref: raw/paper.pdf (92 pages; main text plus embedded Appendices A-K; no separate supplement)
known_items: 17 primary no-display quantitative or analytic claims
22 schematic display items and 11 source/reference-parameter display items
inventory_boundary.reason: The complete 92-page PDF, every caption, Tables I-XIII, Algorithm 1, and embedded Appendices A-K were read end to end. The PDF is the only scientific source bundle. Author code and author numerical arrays were not opened, and source pixels were used only for post-run comparison/style audit, never to infer parameters or generate scientific data.

reproduction_measure.denominator_definition: Every independently adjudicable theory/computation figure series or numerical table region plus every primary quantitative or analytic claim with no corresponding eligible numerical display. Supporting duplicates, schematics, external comparison curves, and source-parameter tables are retained but excluded from the denominator.

acceptance_criteria: All 24 targets execute through one clean-room campaign runner; each target emits structured data and a target-specific attestation check.
T001-T004 run paper-row or reduced independent validations; T009-T010, T018, and T021-T024 run exact, analytic, stochastic, or small-instance scientific checks.
T005-T008, T011-T017, and T019-T020 fail closed on explicit machine-readable publication-input schemas and forbid guessed metadata or printed-output substitution.
Every output is implementation-attestation evidence only; no coverage state or scientific score is promoted by this campaign.
The numerical runner reads no paper PDF, source figure, digitized curve, author numerical array, or author code.
All successful independent numerics are produced under an isolated attested run.
Analytic claims are claim-specific rederivations rather than audit placeholders.
Unfinished targets execute a paper-instance scientific substage and preserve the exact capability boundary.
No author code, author numerical array, digitized curve, or source-image pixel is a numerical input.
